Task cron(int|string $minute, int|string $hour, int|string $day, int|string $month, int|string $weekday)

Schedule the task using crontab-like fields.

Note: Each field accepts: * (any), a single value, a comma-separated list (1,2,5), a range (1-5), a step (*\/5 or 1-30/5), or a combination of these separated by commas.

Parameters

int|string $minute 0-59
int|string $hour 0-23
int|string $day 1-31
int|string $month 1-12
int|string $weekday

0-7 (0 and 7 both mean Sunday)
